- INV-2025-0821: Gross = $56,400.00 — Apply $56,400.00 (VAT flagged: no)
- INV-2025-0833: Gross = $72,125.80 — Apply $72,125.80 (VAT flagged: yes, 20% VAT included in gross)

Bank shows withheld: $12,061.37 — this matches (gross total $190,603.67 minus net $178,542.30).

Recommendation for GL treatment:
- Record full gross invoice applications to clear AR for the three invoices.
- Post withheld $12,061.37 to a temporary "Withholding Receivable" account (1205) until customer supplies tax withholding certificate. Do not net the withholding against a single invoice in case Fathom expects a reclaim/credit.
- If customer provides certificate that allows crediting to tax authorities, move the withholding amount from 1205 to tax credit receivable (1302) and reverse once reclaimed.

Notes:
- Vanessa, per past cases, if the payment originated from Spain and withheld under local law, we will likely need the certificado retenciones to support reclaim/credit. We should not treat it as VAT — it's an income withholding.

Marta — if you can confirm whether the bank withheld under "IRPF" or as a bank fee, that will help. The bank_notice file you sent looks like a SWIFT field that references withholding; if you can provide the bank trace/SWIFT MT103 we can match the MT fields to the three invoices.

I'll hold posting in the ledger until we have the bank trace or certificate; proposed posting will clear the three invoices and open the 1205 withholding receivable.
